★Request
Show Air Messiah (Casual)

I see, I thought.
It was a choice very typical of her, valuing her rest as she did.

I grow some in my room on a regular basis.
Today, I came here in search of new decorative pieces.

Ah... This lava rock has a lovely color. And this pumice too—
—Oh?

Yes, it is possible. Many people spread white sand across the bottom
to give them a cool, refreshing impression.
My—

From Air Messiah's ever-serious personality,
that was the impression I got.

...I am glad to hear you say so.
It feels as though you are praising not just me, but my mother as well.
If that happens, it could even affect the competitive performance of the Umamusume in their charge...

A manga book. Since today is my day off,
I thought I would take my time reading it in my room.

That is why, as a competitor,
one must never neglect their rest.

Catching sight of something that caught my eye,
I walked over and picked it up.

How about you, Trainer?
How do you plan to spend your time resting today?

I follow that philosophy as well.
To demonstrate sufficient performance, and to climb to even greater heights.

What caught her eye was
a slender, tiny piece of driftwood with a curled tip.
My mother—this is how she thought of it.

What I picked up earlier and bought right away because I liked it so much—it was
a very tiny cactus resting in a palm-sized pot.

While nodding in agreement,
I felt this mindset applied just as much to Trainers.

On my day off, when I came to the bookstore to browse training manuals—
I spotted Air Messiah.

Yes. Wondering what kind of charm will reveal itself once I actually raise it—
it is quite intriguing.
A moss terrarium—commonly known as a mossarium.
...Fufu, what an endearing shape.
Yes, the prickles are almost like downy hair... It gives such a warm and comforting feeling, doesn't it?

A spontaneous smile slipped across her face. Her expression was brighter than usual,
relaxed, and gentle.

If performance drops from neglecting rest,
it will eventually affect the guidance given to the Umamusume in one's care.
...Pardon?

Yes.
I believe it allows one to obtain truly meaningful rest.

The size is just right, the color is lovely...
I think it will match what I am currently growing very well.

Taking meaningful rest leads to relaxing both mind and body.
And that, in turn, leads to delivering good performance.

Oh, you haven't decided?
Hmm—

Actually—I explained the situation to her. How I had originally planned to work
today too. And how I always spent my days off like that.

And seeing how Air Messiah clearly separated her on and off time
had given me such a wonderful, positive influence.

I want to cherish moments like these. And I want to be even more supportive
of Air Messiah, I thought once again.

Rest—I hadn't given it any thought.
In fact, I might hardly have any concept of rest to begin with...
Just then—

?
Trainer, you have quite a troubled look on your face. Is something the matter...?

Cherishing the things she loved, spending peaceful time, relaxing.
Seeing her like that was wonderful, and I found myself wishing I could do the same...

—That's right, perhaps I should try it someday too.
Lining up several cacti of different colors and shapes...
Yes, let's go with this one.

Actually, there is a place I plan on stopping by after this.
If you'd like, would you care to join me, Trainer?

To tell the truth, much of my way of thinking regarding rest
comes from what I learned from my mother.

No, it was just on the way while doing my own shopping,
so it really was no trouble at all.

Letting her imagination wander, her shoulders were naturally more relaxed than usual,
giving her a charming innocence befitting a girl her age.

—Ah, Trainer.
Are you shopping?

My, look at all those tiny spines...
What a lovely cactus.

Taking proper rest and relaxing would benefit Air Messiah too.
Thanks to her, I was able to learn that valuable lesson.

A peaceful moment after such a long time.
It feels as though time is flowing so much slower than usual...

The next day—waking up, the tiny cactus immediately caught my eye.
A smile naturally formed on my lips, easing the tension in my heart.

And so, comforted by the little plant—
we set off on the way back to the academy.

At Air Messiah's suggestion, we arrived at a general goods store. What she was
looking at so intently—was something small resting inside glass.

You bought something as well, Trainer.
Whatever could it be?
